correctness.rationale: The substitution fixed sequence satisfies u_q(n)=ν₂(n+1) mod q, from even/odd recursion. The two-sided orbit closure admits an explicit 2-adic odometer parameter c: nonsingular c∉Z has singleton fibre, each ordinary integer c has exactly q points differing only at coordinate -c. Distinct parameters yield different sequences by valuations one apart modulo q; compactness gives continuous factor. Dense nonsingular orbit, asymptotic pairs in singular fibres and an invariant metric show that the odometer is the maximal equicontinuous factor. Every onto equivariant map induces c↦c+a; target r-fold singular fibre implies a∈Z. For r∤q, sequences with valuations L_j≡0 mod q but distinct mod r converge to the same source singular point and different target symbols: contradiction. If r|q, letterwise reduction modulo r is continuous onto, and nonsingular dense fibres force uniqueness of σ^kR. Independent finite substitution/obstruction checks (12 q, 144 modulus pairs) corroborate only local arithmetic, not all sliding block codes.
